findings.passage: What this legislation would do is provide state-level protections as it relates to voting rights.

findings.passage: We should not be in the business of limiting access to voters.
findings.note: Quoted in the Jackson Free Press, as a Hinds County election commissioner, on Senate Bill 2242, which would cut the time to show photo ID after an affidavit ballot from five days to three.
